replacements.reason: Exact GALE01 code returns a wall/ceiling collision bitmask, while ItemStateTable.collided is a predicate callback. The public bitmask function has no source callers outside this table; item.c only copies the callback and tests its truth value. A translation-unit-local typed shim preserves that sole observed contract, retains the original public function and collision side effects, and removes an incompatible-function-pointer call from native C.
